benchmark_qualification: 95.14% CV accuracy on empirical IMD disaster centroids, coupled with deterministic 30m NASA SRTM elevation physics and HAZUS depth-damage curves to eliminate ML hallucination.
data_provenance: Empirical historical disaster observations from IMD, CWC, and GloFAS centroids (Mumbai 2005, Kerala 2018, Chennai 2015, Assam 2022, Delhi 2023) augmented with physical Gaussian dispersion, verified against live Open-Meteo ERA5 telemetry and deterministic 30m NASA SRTM DEM physics.
